card.name: Linking words before CML disease phase
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, for, the and diagnosed right before chronic, accelerated or newly diagnosed phase wording in chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) text. Also a few spots in nearby CML text, like a space before a count or a comma after an abbreviation.

modes.label: Link before phase
modes.description: The word with, for or in directly before chronic, accelerated or blast phase CML.
modes.example: is more frequent in patients with accelerated phase CML or blast crisis than in patients<< with>> chronic phase CML.

modes.label: Newly diagnosed
modes.description: A word such as diagnosed or with leading into newly diagnosed Ph+ CML.
modes.example: The recommended dose of imatinib mesylate tablets for children with newly<< diagnosed>> Ph+ CML is 34

modes.label: Table and abbreviation spots
modes.description: A space inside a blood-count threshold or a comma after a CML phase abbreviation.

card.plain: It fires on small linking words just before a leukemia stage such as chronic phase CML is named.
